definitions.gloss: spring equinox period; spring higan; spring week of Buddhist memorial services
definitions.explanation: A seven-day period centered on the spring equinox (around March 20-21), during which Japanese families visit ancestral graves and make offerings. One of two annual higan periods, the other being {秋彼岸|あきひがん}.

examples.japanese: {春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to visit the graves during the spring equinox period.

examples.japanese: {春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぼた{餅|もち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{供|そな}え→お供え：25860_osonae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of offering botamochi during the spring equinox period.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり、{春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As the saying 'heat and cold last until higan' goes, it gets warmer after the spring equinox period.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ ('spring') and ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ ('the other shore' in Buddhism; equinox period). ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ literally means 'the far shore' ({彼|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧), referring to the Buddhist concept of the shore of enlightenment, and the equinox — when day and night are equal — symbolizes the balance between this world and the next.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The seven-day period spans three days before, the equinox day itself, and three days after
- The main activities are visiting family graves (⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧), cleaning gravestones, and offering flowers and food
- The traditional offering is ⟦{牡丹餅|ぼたもち}→牡丹餅：29357_botamochi⟧ (botamochi), named after the spring peony flower (⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}→牡丹：13488_botan⟧)
- The autumn equivalent offering is {御萩|おはぎ} (ohagi), named after the bush clover ({萩|はぎ})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧: spring equinox grave visit
- {春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入|い}り: start of the spring higan period
- {春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中日|ちゅうにち}: the middle day (equinox itself)
- {春彼岸|はるひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧: end of the spring higan period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秋彼岸|あきひがん}→秋彼岸：24286_akihigan⟧: autumn equinox period — the same type of observance around the autumn equinox in September
- ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧: equinox period (general) — can refer to either spring or autumn higan
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧: Obon; Bon festival — the other major ancestor memorial period, held in mid-August
